mapper.sql: select e.data_id, e.farmland_id, f.farmland_name, e.temperature, e.humidity, e.light_intensity, e.soil_moisture, e.wind_speed, e.record_time, e.create_by, e.create_time from agri_env_data e left join agri_farmland f on e.farmland_id = f.farmland_id
mapper.select:
AND e.farmland_id = #{farmlandId}
ORDER BY e.record_time DESC
mapper.insert: insert into agri_env_data(farmland_id, temperature, humidity, light_intensity, soil_moisture, wind_speed, record_time, create_by, create_time) values(#{farmlandId}, #{temperature}, #{humidity}, #{lightIntensity}, #{soilMoisture}, #{windSpeed}, #{recordTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
